group-2020-bing-seven-choices.overview: 本文是一篇说明文，介绍乔迁派对（housewarming party）：定义、由谁举办、送礼习俗、派对上的食物与活动安排，以及这一名称的历史由来。七选五考查对各段主题句、过渡句与衔接句的把握。

discourseStructure.summary: 首段定义乔迁派对并点明其意义；第二段讲送礼习俗（礼品登记单与装饰类礼物）；第三段讲带食物分享及派对上的活动安排（参观新居、帮忙拆箱）；末段追溯名称由来——旧时送柴取暖，如今多用中央供暖。

units.summary: 定义乔迁派对并说明其作为亲友祝贺、共享喜悦场合的意义。
介绍带礼物的习俗：礼品登记单上常见的厨具、窗帘，以及艺术品、植物等装饰类礼物。
可带食物饮料分享，因派对供食不多；通常无固定游戏活动，但主人会带客人参观新居，有时请客人帮忙拆箱。
追溯名称由来：旧时人们带柴薪做礼物以供过冬取暖，如今多用中央供暖。

topicClues: congratulate the person on the new home
a chance for friends and family
fill the new space with love

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: The party is a chance for friends and family to congratulate the person on the new home.
contextEvidence.afterQuote: And it is a good time to fill the new space with love and hopefully presents.

mechanismSignals.signalText: see what the new home looks like
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项 E 中 the new home 与空前 the new home 同指，承接派对意义这一话题场。

mechanismSignals.targetText: a chance for friends and family / a chance to see the new home
mechanismSignals.relation: also 表并列追加，把空前"祝贺新居"的功能与"看新家"这一新功能并列起来。

mechanismSignals.targetText: it is a good time to fill the new space
mechanismSignals.relation: 空后 And it is a good time... 继续以 also/And 罗列派对的多重意义，要求所填句同为派对意义之一。

optionFit.fitSummary: 首段在罗列乔迁派对的意义，空前说"祝贺新居"，E 用 It also gives people a chance to see what the new home looks like 追加"让人参观新家"这一意义，并与空后 And it is a good time... 形成并列罗列。

matchedClues.contextSide: a chance for friends and family to congratulate
matchedClues.optionSide: It also gives people a chance to see
matchedClues.relation: option 中 also 与 a chance 呼应空前的 a chance，把新意义并列追加。

matchedClues.optionSide: what the new home looks like
matchedClues.relation: the new home 重复衔接，紧扣首段话题。

keyDistractors.reason: F（鼓励老友相聚）也谈派对功能，但缺少 also/the new home 的并列与重复衔接，且"old friends get together"在首段无对应线索。

q-2020-bing-036.teachingNote: 段末罗列功能的空，优先找含 also/and 等并列词且重复上文关键名词（the new home）的选项。

topicClues: things they want or need for their new home

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: Some people register a list of things they want or need for their new home at a local store or stores.
contextEvidence.afterQuote: Even if there isn’t a registry, a good housewarming gift is something to decorate the new house with

mechanismSignals.signalText: bring a gift to a housewarming party
mechanismSignals.targetText: a good housewarming gift / gift registry
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项 B 的 gift 与本段反复出现的 gift registry、housewarming gift 同属"送礼"话题场，是段落主题句。
空后 gift registry、housewarming gift 围绕"礼物"展开，正是 B 中 gift 这一主题词的具体化。

mechanismSignals.targetText: register a list of things / a good housewarming gift
mechanismSignals.relation: B 以 It is traditional 概括"带礼物"的习俗，统领下文登记单与装饰礼物两类做法。

optionFit.fitSummary: 本段通篇围绕"送礼"，先讲礼品登记单，再讲装饰类礼物。B（带礼物到乔迁派对是传统）正是统领全段的主题句。

matchedClues.contextSide: register a list of things / a good housewarming gift
matchedClues.optionSide: It is traditional to bring a gift
matchedClues.relation: 下文两种送礼做法都是 B 所述"带礼物"传统的展开。

keyDistractors.reason: D（收到礼物要妥善保管）也含 gift，但视角在"收礼者保管礼物"，与本段"送礼者带什么礼"的展开方向不符，无法统领下文。

q-2020-bing-037.teachingNote: 段首主题句的空，找能被本段所有细节共同支撑、概括整段话题（送礼）的选项。

topicClues: there isn’t a lot of food served

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: This is often appreciated since at a housewarming there isn’t a lot of food served.
contextEvidence.afterQuote: There are usually no planned activities like games at a housewarming party.

mechanismSignals.targetText: bring food or drinks to share
mechanismSignals.relation: 空后 This is often appreciated 的 This 指代所填句"带食物饮料分享"这一行为，构成指代衔接。

mechanismSignals.targetText: there isn’t a lot of food served
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项 C 的 food or drinks 与空后 food served 同属"食物"话题场，解释了为何带食物会被 appreciated。

mechanismSignals.signalText: there isn’t a lot of food served
mechanismSignals.relation: 因派对供食不多，故带食物分享受欢迎，与 C 形成因果支撑。

optionFit.fitSummary: 空后用 This is often appreciated since... isn’t a lot of food served 解释原因，This 必须指代"带食物"这一行为，故选 C（也可带食物饮料与其他客人分享）。

matchedClues.contextSide: This is often appreciated / isn’t a lot of food served
matchedClues.optionSide: bring food or drinks to share with the other guests
matchedClues.relation: C 提供了 This 的指代对象，并与"供食不多"形成因果。

keyDistractors.reason: B 也是带某物到派对，但带的是"礼物"而非"食物"，无法解释空后 isn’t a lot of food served 的"食物"语境。

q-2020-bing-038.teachingNote: 段首空若空后出现 This/It 等指代词，所填句须是该指代词能指回的具体行为（这里是带食物）。

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: people may be asked to help unpack boxes.

mechanismSignals.targetText: people may be asked to help unpack boxes
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项 A 的 This 指代空前"客人被请来帮忙拆箱"这件事，构成段末指代衔接。

mechanismSignals.targetText: no planned activities / may be asked to help unpack boxes
mechanismSignals.relation: A 中 though 表转折让步，指出"帮忙拆箱"并非常态，与上文"通常无固定活动"语气一致。

mechanismSignals.targetText: may be asked to help unpack boxes
mechanismSignals.relation: isn’t usual 评注空前"有时被请帮忙拆箱"这一非常规情形，收束本段。

optionFit.fitSummary: 空前讲"有时客人会被请来帮忙拆箱"，A（This isn’t usual though）用 This 回指这件事，并以 isn’t usual...though 评注其非常态，恰好收尾本段。

matchedClues.contextSide: people may be asked to help unpack boxes
matchedClues.relation: This 指代帮忙拆箱一事，isn’t usual 说明这并不常见。

keyDistractors.reason: C 谈带食物，话题已在前文 q38 用过，且与空前"帮忙拆箱"无指代或逻辑联系，无法收尾。

q-2020-bing-039.teachingNote: 段末空看选项里的 This/It 能否回指紧邻上句的具体事件，能回指且语气连贯者即为答案。

topicClues: bring firewood to a new home as a gift

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: people would actually bring firewood to a new home as a gift.
contextEvidence.afterQuote: Now most homes have central heating and don’t use fires to keep warm.

mechanismSignals.targetText: bring firewood to a new home as a gift
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项 G 的 This 指代空前"带柴薪做乔迁礼物"这一旧俗，构成指代衔接。

mechanismSignals.signalText: keep their home warm for the winter
mechanismSignals.targetText: use fires to keep warm / central heating
mechanismSignals.relation: G 中 keep their home warm 与空前 firewood、空后 keep warm/central heating 同属"取暖"话题场。

mechanismSignals.targetText: keep their home warm for the winter
mechanismSignals.relation: 空后 keep warm 与 G 的 keep their home warm 形成 then-now 对照，承上启下。

optionFit.fitSummary: 空前说旧时带柴薪做礼物，G（This was so that the person could keep their home warm for the winter）用 This 回指送柴薪一事并说明目的——供冬天取暖，自然引出空后"如今用中央供暖"的对照。

matchedClues.contextSide: bring firewood to a new home as a gift
matchedClues.optionSide: This was so that the person could keep their home warm
matchedClues.relation: This 指代送柴薪，并解释其取暖目的，与空后 central heating 形成古今对比。

keyDistractors.reason: D 也以条件句谈收到礼物，但话题在"保管礼物"，与本段"取暖由来"的 firewood/keep warm 话题场不符。

q-2020-bing-040.teachingNote: 段中承接句的空，找用 This 回指上句旧俗、并能顺势引出空后古今对照的选项。
